compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, the review workflow auto-dispatches cycle-K re-review and halts when finding sets are stable (Jaccard >= 0.85)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story

As a sprint orchestrator, the review workflow auto-dispatches cycle-K re-review and halts when the finding set is stable (Jaccard similarity ≥ 0.85 between consecutive cycles), so review loops terminate predictably even when `max_cycles` has not been reached.

## Done Definitions

- [ ] `REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` updated with cycle-K dispatch logic: after each cycle, if unresolved findings remain AND cycle < max_cycles, orchestrator auto-dispatches next cycle without user prompt
- [ ] Adaptive stability halt: after cycle K, compute Jaccard similarity between cycle K and cycle K-1 finding sets; if ≥ 0.85, halt and emit `STABLE_HALT` signal regardless of remaining cycles
- [ ] Zero-set edge case handled: if either cycle's finding set is empty, Jaccard is defined as 1.0 (full agreement) — halt immediately with `STABLE_HALT`
- [ ] Finding set normalization is identical between local and CI paths; normalization logic (what constitutes "the same finding") is documented in a comment or contracts doc
- [ ] `oscillation_no_arbiter_engagement` gate in `REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` reconciled: either (a) the gate is updated to account for cycle-K auto-dispatch, or (b) a ticket is filed for the conflict and this story documents the known gap
- [ ] At least one test covers Jaccard ≥ 0.85 halt (stable), Jaccard < 0.85 continuation, and zero-set halt

## Considerations

- [Gate conflict] Existing `oscillation_no_arbiter_engagement` gate fires when arbiter has not engaged after N cycles — verify this gate is not triggered spuriously by the new auto-dispatch path; if it conflicts, document and file a follow-on ticket rather than silently disabling it
- [Normalization] Finding identity for Jaccard must use a stable hash of (file, line_range, category) — NOT free-form message text, which can vary between cycles; define and document this in the story implementation
- [Parity] Local path uses cycle-ledger.json; CI path reconstructs from PR comments — verify Jaccard computation is identical regardless of source
- [Escalation policy] Escalate when blocked

comments.body: WIRING GAP from S3: runner.py does not yet call dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter. S3 rewrote the arbiter module/schema/tests. S4 must wire the cycle-end dispatch into runner.py — both at the max_cycles hard-cap path AND at the Jaccard stability halt signal. Without this, the arbiter is never triggered in production and end-to-end PR validation (required for epic closure per user) cannot be done. Add as a mandatory DD: 'runner.py calls dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter at cycle-end (both max_cycles and Jaccard-halt paths); verified by end-to-end PR review triggering the arbiter and returning BLOCK/DEFER/DROP decisions.'
